name: dropdown-menu
useFor: Use for actions on an item or a compact navigation menu. Set variant="glass" for a menu that opens from the header's glass tray. Use onSelect for actions and DropdownMenuHoldItem for destructive actions that require a hold.
constraints: Menus for navigation that should be visible
More than one level of submenu

title: Dropdown menu
description: Action menu with white and frosted glass panels, submenus and selection controls.
